payload.description: Calf is a library that allows you to easily create adaptive UIs and access platform specific APIs with Compose Multiplatform (Adaptive UI, File Picker, WebView, Permissions...).

issue.title: AdaptiveNavigationBar on iOS - bottom bar is visible when navigating away, and during back navigation gestures

comment.body:
> not confirmed but i believe i am having similar issues with the topbar instead.
> 
> the two topappbars of both screens are displayed (overlayed on each other) when navigating
> 

Yeah I went with native navigation instead. Although this library is really great, this specific use case with top/bottom navigation is not usable.
